summary: FD_TC_028_Travel Completed | APPR | Multiple VOLs before INVOL | Promise = Last VOL | Delay 7 hrs
title: Travel Completed | APPR | Multiple VOLs before INVOL | Promise = Last VOL | Delay 7 hrs
description:
Validates promise calculation when customer made TWO voluntary changes before the airline made an involuntary change. Promise must update to the LAST VOL arrival time before the first INVOL. Tests the most complex booking change sequence at Tier 2 compensation. Confirms DDS handles multiple VOL changes correctly and doesn't use the first VOL or the 14-day mark.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Original (14-day) arrival: 08:00. Change 1 (D-12): VOL via Manage My Booking (aircanada.com) � customer changed flight online, new arrival 10:00.
Change 2 (D-8): VOL via Manage My Booking (aircanada.com) � customer changed to a later flight, new arrival 12:00.
Change 3 (D-2): INVOL � AC cancelled and rebooked, new arrival 19:00.. Actual arrival: 19:00. Arrival delay code: 67 (Cabin Crew Shortage). Carrier: AC only.
